'''Strawberry Seeds''' are a type of seed. Mature plants yield [[Strawberry|Strawberries]].

They can be purchased for {{Price|100}} at the [[Egg Festival]], on the first and third days of the [[Desert Festival]] from the [[Desert Festival#Calico Egg Merchant|Calico Egg Merchant]] for {{Price|5|Calico}} and {{Price|6|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s respectively, or from [[Maru]]'s [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] at the Desert Festival. They can also be obtained by using the [[Seed Maker]].

When harvested, each Strawberry plant gives 1 Strawberry every 4 days, with a small random chance for more Strawberries.<ref name="extraharvest" />

==Notes==
<references>
<ref name="extraharvest">The game generates a random number between 0 and 1, and if it is less than 0.02, then another Strawberry will spawn.  This repeats until the random number is greater than or equal to 0.02, at which point the chance for an extra Strawberry ends.  Daily [[Luck]] can double the amount of extra Strawberries spawned by the above formula.</ref>
</references>
*Unlike most other types of seed, Strawberry Seeds have no sell value. Therefore, unlike other multi-harvest crops, it is not profitable to process the crops with a [[Seed Maker]].
